page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No margin notes. Closing word "EX." at the lower right, after the text.

main_text.p: infidet hoc veneni genus,expurgat. Hinc enim sudore prauos humores prolicit. Hius generis sunt lignum gaiacum, iunipe-rus,buxus,schina & salza parilla,folia pen-taphylli,cardui benedicti idem efficere creduntur. Attamen semen huius validius agit.Ex interiore cortice fraxini & radice chamaeleonis albi,qui pharmacopolis carlina dicitur,ad hunc affectum sit eximium & singulare remedium. Corruptos enim humores venenatos per sudores mire propellit:quemadmodum in Lugdunea peste cum felici successu experti sumus.Sumantur ergo corticis selibra & radicis unciae tres, aquae fontis librae nouem: dein haec ferueant donec sex superfint, & decoctum fiat,de quo aeger capiat mane uncias sex,& tarundem[?] velperi horis tribus ante pastus. Provocatus inde sudor acurate detergat. Ratio victus sit tenuis, & exiccans, potus quoq; ex decocti magmate fiat, de quo bibat aeger pro arbitrio utriusq; angelicae, ac imperatoriae radices sic praeparatae idem praestare possunt.

page.notes: Long s is printed as f throughout (for example "fudore", "fchina", "falza", "fingulare"); transcribed as plain s. "tarundem" is doubtful and marked [?]. The page number "221" may read "22ı" or similar; marked [?]. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the lower half of the page is not transcribed. The text is printed as one paragraph, and the lines from "cae,ac" to "possunt." are set indented but continue it. Printing errors are left as printed.
